datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data across Somalia on a monthly basis (February, June, October 2017). Geographic polygons with IPC phase classifications were compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats to represent spatial distribution of acute food insecurity severity across administrative units.
